7a5bd559f617238ec6e9a4f1f06a2a53.text: On Sunday in La Liga, Villarreal and Getafe drew 1-1 after goals from Ikechukwu Uche and Diego Castro. The match was overshadowed by Villarreal defender Mateo Musacchio suffering a broken and dislocated left ankle during the game, requiring successful surgery at a Madrid clinic later that night.

f435b982d877f3b570126d479b521b93.text: This week in Scranton, Pennsylvania, police are investigating after the headstone of Hillary Clinton's father, Hugh Rodham, was found tipped over at a cemetery. Discovered just days after Clinton announced her White House run, authorities and locals suspect vandalism, though weather is also being considered as a possible cause.

1678b605bfb553ba152d89e549186a9e.text: Fewer than twenty percent of Massachusetts residents want Boston Marathon bomber Dzhokhar Tsarnaev executed, with most preferring a life sentence because they believe death is too easy an escape. As the penalty phase of his trial begins, his defense team will present witnesses to avoid the death penalty.

29121e9a6b47c3f4b7b6dba5f1c65573.text: On February 21, millionaire company director Ronan Ghosh, 39, stole £200 worth of meat and wine from a Tesco store in Birmingham. Captured on CCTV, he pleaded guilty to theft at Birmingham Crown Court. Judge Murray Creed sentenced him to a 12-month community order, 80 hours of unpaid work, and £575 in costs.

54eb2a71944cdd80acf80e0c6909b6cf.text: Following their derby defeat to Manchester United, reigning Premier League champions Manchester City trained at the Etihad Campus on Wednesday. Under manager Manuel Pellegrini, fourth-placed City prepared for Sunday's home match against West Ham. Meanwhile, reports suggest the club may listen to summer offers for Yaya Toure and Samir Nasri.

7fc25ccb1aae2275b401127ef9f6ea0b.text: On Friday, defense attorneys for Hummelstown police Officer Lisa Mearkle asked a judge to prevent the release of a stun gun video showing her fatally shooting unarmed motorist David Kassick in the back on February 2 in Pennsylvania. Mearkle, charged with criminal homicide, claims self-defense ahead of Monday’s preliminary hearing.

33f121f30fce870c24370fea4f86bc38.text: Lehigh County District Attorney Jim Martin stated that 14-year-old Jamie Silvonek should remain in an adult jail while awaiting trial for homicide and conspiracy. Silvonek and her boyfriend, 20-year-old soldier Caleb Barnes, are accused of fatally stabbing her mother, Cheryl Silvonek, last month after the mother opposed their relationship.

38ff27a41faa33c2f307dc19dec2b25d.text: An Indian special court sentenced former Satyam Computer Services chairman Ramalinga Raju and nine others to seven years in prison and fined Raju $804,000 for a massive 2009 corporate fraud involving inflated profits and book manipulation. Investigators convicted the group of cheating, criminal conspiracy, and breach of public trust.

e2c1cb38cc26892a852c50fcf4d369ca.text: Marking Autism Awareness Day on April 2, Autism Assistance Dogs are highlighted for significantly improving the lives of children with autism and their families. According to GuideDogs SA, these specially trained dogs enhance safety, independence, and inclusion by preventing children from bolting, improving communication, and providing crucial social and emotional support.

748c5a7f39d584842c00e2ad40460f16.text: Following Arsenal’s goalless draw against Chelsea, former player Thierry Henry stated on Sky Sports that his former club must sign a goalkeeper, centre back, holding midfielder, and top-quality striker in the summer transfer window. Henry also claimed Arsenal cannot win the Premier League title with Olivier Giroud as their first-choice striker.

cfe97e9e5bf25dac1a87b6983c7ea1a0.text: Today, the North Yorkshire Moors Railway launched its three-day Spring Steam Gala. Crowds gathered to watch restored classic locomotives, including "The Great Marquess" and "Sir Nigel Gresley," haul passengers between Pickering and Whitby. The popular heritage event features seven preserved engines, scenic moors views, and additional dates from April 24 to 26.

a18954cf19e6a2d14ea10852f0bad699.text: Twenty-two-year-old Ravel Morrison posted an Instagram picture in his new Lazio bathrobe. After being released by West Ham due to disciplinary issues, Morrison is currently training with the Serie A side. Having signed a pre-contract in January, he will debut next season because of squad registration delays.

a4108816494a1b7494151a70bbf2385a.text: On Thursday in San Francisco, U.S. District Court Judge Jon Tigar ordered California's corrections department to provide sex change surgery to 51-year-old inmate Michelle-Lael Norsworthy. Ruling that denying the procedure violates her constitutional rights, this marks the first time such an operation has been ordered in the state.

3aaa159207ce1ce22183d1e9cde4cf03.text: Eleven-year-old James Creag from Salford, Greater Manchester, who suffers from a rare sunlight allergy called Erythropoietic Protoporphyria, has stopped wearing his protective brown suncream after being racially abused by strangers in the street. Because he refuses the cream, he can no longer safely go outside in the sun.

2e7baae5da2a092d474c779dc20ad06a.text: On Wednesday, Paris Saint-Germain striker Zlatan Ibrahimovic scored a hat-trick against Saint-Etienne, bringing his total tally to 102 goals for the French club. The victory secured a 4-1 win, keeping Paris Saint-Germain on course for a quadruple. Ibrahimovic now trails only Pedro Pauleta in the club's all-time scoring record books.

be58de709b2bcf69ad5c87399fece16f.text: A young boy in Thailand caught a fish using a plastic toy fishing rod by a lake in a viral video. An expert suggested the catch is likely a Nile Tilapia, a popular and common fish in Thailand. While the video amassed over one million views, some viewers suggested the catch might be a hoax.

fc780964091140d260ca6cef52959883.text: Ahead of the upcoming Manchester derby at Old Trafford, sports analysts BSports predict Manchester City will win. Louis van Gaal’s Manchester United have recently hit good form, while Manuel Pellegrini’s reigning champions Manchester City have suffered crushing defeats at Burnley and Crystal Palace, denting their title retention chances.

a2782f6487f71971970d075863640f99.text: Investigators leading a Home Office inquiry into the 1989 Hillsborough disaster have released photographs of fans who tended to the wounded on the pitch. Led by Assistant Commissioner Jon Stoddart of Operation Resolve, the appeal urges the public to identify these individuals to help answer victims' families' questions during ongoing inquests.

f5ab6f0fd9c3dac88a1deca001bdf898.text: In a television interview, shadow chancellor Ed Balls refused to rule out a five-point rise in corporation tax if Labour forms the next government. Meanwhile, Prime Minister David Cameron pledged that billions of pounds of state-owned Lloyds bank shares will be sold off to the public at a discount within a year.

99b5d73482cbb548cfeda836dd20bf6c.text: British citizen Louise Henderson Alakil and her two young daughters are trapped in a basement shelter in Sanaa, Yemen, amid heavy bombing and fighting. With expired passports and closed UK authorities, the family is urgently appealing for evacuation to the UK, facing severe shortages of food, water, and money.

6e7a25b112ab4a25fdaaabf9f61f4237.text: Adrian Schaffner was videoed skiing down the Minschuns resort in Val Müstair, Switzerland, with his dog, Sintha, calmly perched on his shoulders. Sintha grew comfortable being carried after surviving a childhood accident. After reaching the bottom, the dog jumped down, barked, and happily chased other skiers in the snow.

e2ca688298ff623589d9ba2872270193.text: Paul Doyle, 56, was jailed for 16 years at Manchester Crown Court after admitting to heading a drugs ring that supplied cocaine, heroin, cannabis, and amphetamines. Doyle funded a luxury lifestyle in Altrincham, Cheshire, through drug trafficking, money laundering, and benefit fraud between 2012 and 2014, before police arrested him.

152efd2f62e82762f3d0cfd1969aa585.text: Mercedes driver Lewis Hamilton seized pole position for the Chinese Grand Prix in Shanghai, beating teammate Nico Rosberg by just four hundredths of a second on his final lap. Rosberg expressed frustration over the narrow defeat. Ferrari's Sebastian Vettel will start in third place following Saturday's qualifying session.

8984309dc20f8c0208267eeb92e50a95.text: Manchester City manager Manuel Pellegrini admitted that the club must buy young talent because current Academy players are not ready for the first team. The pressure to acquire homegrown players also follows a proposal by FA chairman Greg Dyke. City has been linked with players like Liverpool's Raheem Sterling.

56236134e00e525eee200944238f4fee.text: The Daily Mirror published CCTV footage of the £60 million Hatton Garden heist in London over the Easter weekend 21 hours before Scotland Yard released the images. While a tabloid source claimed the police missed the crucial evidence, detectives insisted they had already recovered the footage at the earliest opportunity.

bbd489e723a23266845fc1dd9c66da55.text: At Villa Park, Aston Villa and Queens Park Rangers drew in a thrilling match. Christian Benteke scored a hat-trick for Villa, while Matt Phillips, Clint Hill, and Charlie Austin scored for QPR. Despite Benteke's three goals, defensive frailties left Tim Sherwood's Aston Villa side struggling near the relegation zone.

41c4df398aa32c1c9f632ae2fc6537e4.text: On Thursday morning in downtown Toronto, a crane operator named Rob MacFarlane photographed a raccoon named Little Mac after the animal climbed nearly 700 feet up a tower crane near the Rogers Centre. The raccoon safely climbed back down unhurt to sleep elsewhere, an event operator noted is not unusual for the city.

bb4f5a49a7cc1b29b0aa55f9ce25e4cf.text: Researchers at Duke-NUS Graduate Medical School in Singapore published a study in the American Journal of Hypertension showing that eating out just once more per week raises the risk of pre-hypertension by six percent. Surveying 501 young adults in Singapore, the team linked frequent dining out and takeaways to elevated blood pressure.

6c15fbe24778593265fdf07244e25f36.text: Inventors David Blaauw and Dennis Sylvester created the Michigan Micro Mote, the world's smallest complete computer system, measuring less than two millimeters across. Powered perpetually by solar cells using ambient light, these tiny smart sensors process data and communicate via radio frequencies for medical, industrial, and security applications.

5e9dadc58d9246fa8e5f0fcac0b248a9.text: England Sevens international Jeff Williams, 26, has signed with Aviva Premiership side Bath for next season. The South Africa-born back, who recently helped England win the Tokyo Sevens and has scored 36 World Series tries, will move to the Recreation Ground at the end of the current season.

e0d462901345d28552aab99766b6d50c.text: On Sunday, March 29, at 5 pm, an employee at Scooter's Coffee in Omaha clicked a malicious link, allowing hackers to lock the company's Facebook page for nearly 24 hours. The unknown third party flooded the account with adult cartoons before Facebook finally removed the content and restored access.

d2b6d648dd6beb3a517531a9d86b1861.text: A recent UK survey revealed that over half of children eat no vegetables and 44 percent consume no fruit daily, amidst rising childhood obesity. In response, food expert Annabel Karmel has shared advice and creative recipe tips to help parents encourage fussy children to eat nutritious foods.

ab711a6255c66866f3372fb6ccddf367.text: Sale suffered a surprising 25-23 defeat against Irish at the Madejski Stadium, damaging their European Champions Cup qualification hopes. Despite tries from Tom Arscott and Mike Haley, critical errors and penalties cost Sale the match, allowing Irish to secure the win through tries from Alex Lewington and Andrew Fenby.

c3ac775d5087c65e06522924811e6229.text: Brazilian football icon Ronaldo stated he would love to play alongside Cristiano Ronaldo if he competed in the modern era. The former striker, who retired in 2011, co-owns the North American club Fort Lauderdale Strikers and hinted he might play again if the team reaches the playoffs.

c73de7163d365ba6870d930ec1f27c50.text: Sunday's match against QPR at Loftus Road marks Chelsea’s 700th game under owner Roman Abramovich, who bought the club in 2003. Manager Jose Mourinho praised Abramovich's twelve-year ownership, citing numerous trophies won and adherence to Financial Fair Play, while predicting future Chelsea teams will supply more English national players.

baadd6a1a3003be283d7664b15b99441.text: Tom O'Carroll, a former leading member of the Paedophile Information Exchange, attended a Hacked Off rally at the Houses of Parliament on February 25. O'Carroll joined supporters of the media pressure group to lobby MPs for state involvement in press regulation during the meeting chaired by John Cleese.

399876a2c91cf8e28f677e9ee48a61b9.text: French National Front founder Jean-Marie Le Pen, 86, withdrew yesterday from December's regional elections in south-east France. Following a family rift caused by his controversial remarks about the Holocaust and Marshal Petain, he suggested his 25-year-old granddaughter, Marion Marechal-Le Pen, replace him as a candidate. She subsequently confirmed she would seek the nomination.

7c55caebfe03928c011340897445076d.text: The International Association of Athletics Federations Council bypassed its usual bidding process to award Eugene, United States, the rights to host the 2021 IAAF World Championships. Despite losing the 2019 bid to Doha, the IAAF chose Eugene to seize a unique strategic opportunity to host the event in the USA.

648d7955414eea1ed6c02589d1717bf2.text: In a recent interview with Times2, 69-year-old Oscar-winning actress Dame Helen Mirren stated that the 1970s was a horrible and perilous time for women. Speaking ahead of the release of her new film, Woman in Gold, Mirren also discussed her co-star Ryan Reynolds and her experiences during that era.

06085f1005e96d044be19e18f67bfcf3.text: In a Friday op-ed for The Washington Post, former California governor Arnold Schwarzenegger strongly criticized Indiana’s newly passed Religious Freedom Restoration Act. Schwarzenegger argued that the divisive legislation harms the country and hurts the Republican Party by alienating key voters, urging the GOP instead to focus on real solutions and equality.

2b5d8c586e3956167e4ba6ac935b4301.text: In April 2015, detention centre operator Transfield Services suspended eight guards on Nauru. The employees, part of the emergency response team, were stood down during an investigation after being pictured with Pauline Hanson at a Brisbane Reclaim Australia rally and posting anti-Islamic messages on social media that breached company policy.

c56359d9919702761b3e5e1b4d2551b8.text: In 2009, Canadian expat Lisa Webb moved to France, where she later observed school children eating diverse, three-course meals. Writing on her blog, Canadian Expat Mom, the former teacher expressed initial shock when her own vegetable-phobic three-year-old daughter successfully ate everything served during school lunch breaks.

6929c61f45ccaf1a6438a1cdb5dfe860.text: New York City police have released an image of a distinctive heart tattoo to help identify an unnamed woman, aged 25 to 45, who died on March 22. She was found unconscious in the Gravesend section of Brooklyn and pronounced dead that evening. Police await a medical examiner's report on her cause of death.

029c434255b728d7fb0ad9ca07898ac5.text: Atlanta-based photographer and mother Kate T. Parker created a powerful photography series titled "Strong is the New Pretty." Evolving over the past year, the project features candid images of her two daughters and their friends playing sports and enjoying childhood, celebrating their strength, confidence, and authentic selves.

d6fef3d990c44f57eb450d78069303b6.text: On Staten Island, 40-year-old UPS driver Tom Ryan lost a leg after being crushed against his truck by a Toyota. The driver swerved to avoid a jaywalker. Onlookers provided first aid before Ryan was hospitalized. He is expected to survive, and police filed no charges against the driver.

5bff47fe544117d9efe7cffde9311c38.text: Following recent scrutiny of British Prime Minister David Cameron’s kitchen, etiquette expert William Hanson has created a household audit. Based on specific items like cafetieres, agas, reed diffusers, and plain loo paper, the test determines whether a home achieves an upmarket status according to upper-class standards.

0eb080ea0fdf0f09624817b0ea608867.text: Naturopathic doctor Lara Briden claims that premenstrual syndrome (PMS), including irritability and fatigue, can be eliminated through natural treatments. According to Dr. Briden, PMS is linked to chronic inflammation rather than hormone levels. By changing her diet to avoid deep-fried foods and desserts, and taking magnesium and vitamin B6 supplements, a patient successfully relieved her symptoms.

116da50b13df27871469b913b675d6e4.text: Ukip leader Nigel Farage stated he would abstain from drinking alcohol until 6pm to keep his mind clear before facing six other party leaders in a two-hour live television election debate in Salford. The multi-party debate, featuring David Cameron and Ed Miliband, takes place tonight from 8pm to 10pm.

3388e7379fde514dee7c461085cef401.text: On Friday in Northampton County, Pennsylvania, 37-year-old Kenneth Wanamaker Jr. pleaded guilty to reckless endangerment and false swearing. His plea follows the discovery that fourteen of his six-year-old daughter's twenty teeth were abscessed, posing a potentially fatal health threat after her parents failed to schedule pre-operation examinations.

80b819de4befc8f7cbc8c8947d0bf00e.text: On Sunday, ISIS released a video showing the execution of two groups of prisoners in Libya. On Monday, the Ethiopian government confirmed that 30 of its citizens were among the victims. One group was beheaded on a Mediterranean beach, and the other was shot in Southern Libya.

72e6b79493a2b7d697dcd009842634de.text: Kelly Ilczyszyn is filing a wrongful death lawsuit against Southwest Airlines after her 46-year-old husband, Richard Ilczyszyn, suffered a fatal heart attack on an Orange County-bound flight. Flight attendants allegedly ignored his groaning in the bathroom, mistaking him for an unruly passenger and a security risk, and failed to seek immediate medical help.

1c2ddd577d604875897930b32ca50ebd.text: Every spring in Kawasaki, Japan, residents and tourists celebrate the Shinto Kanamara Matsuri festival, carrying three giant phalluses through the streets. Started nearly 40 years ago at the Kanayama Shrine, the popular event raises HIV awareness and features prayers to a fertility god for childbirth, health, and protection from sexually transmitted infections.

4596175658327bc0df56c5952ddccfea.text: Australia recalled its ambassador to Indonesia after Indonesia executed eight drug smugglers, including Australians Andrew Chan and Myuran Sukumaran, by firing squad early Wednesday. Australian Prime Minister Tony Abbott condemned the executions as cruel. Indonesian President Joko Widodo defended the actions, stating Indonesia's legal sovereignty must be respected.

452d2d33a01d2427c3b1233b35644acf.text: On Tuesday, Barcelona manager Luis Enrique stated that 35-year-old midfielder Xavi will have a vital role in the team's pursuit of a treble during the final months of the season. Despite recently discussing a possible move to Qatar's Al Sadd, Xavi recently assisted a winning goal against Celta Vigo.

d3c853c7fb2443aa3a00306a176fc305.text: Thousands of migrants and refugees are arriving in Sicily from Libya, driven by the absence of port control following Moammar Gadhafi's overthrow. The Italian Coast Guard reported over 10,000 arrivals since last weekend. Despite rescue efforts and European border missions, migrants continue crossing the Mediterranean seeking a better life in Europe.

8ba1201e4243421f0583f48244171a7d.text: On Tuesday, authorities arrested 60-year-old Carmem Dierks in west Orange County, Florida, for allegedly operating an unlicensed dental clinic and unregistered dental lab. During a raid, officers found dental equipment, patient files, and two patients undergoing treatment. Dierks, trained in Brazil but uncertified in Florida, posted bond on Wednesday.

dc5b6ac482c85136b276984c1b4f7fb8.text: A popular Reddit thread recently shared insights from men who bought mail-order brides from Russia, the Philippines, and Thailand. Participants discussed surprising marital realities, high costs ranging from $10,000 to $50,000, and communication barriers. Meanwhile, the global mail-order bride industry continues to grow through platforms like Russianbrides.com.

3e084cc7dc0b62ad3e81c211fde6e2d7.text: In Whitley Bay, North Tyneside, Lindsey Walker and her family endured a ruined overnight stay at the Rex Hotel following a hospital stay. At 4am, facing poor room conditions, loud nightclub noise, and neighbors inviting them to a party with escorts, the frightened family fled to the hotel reception.

c86cb94c31b95db77d815fc1816821ed.text: On Sunday, defending champion the Czech Republic reached its fourth Fed Cup final in five years by defeating France. Petra Kvitova secured the insurmountable 3-0 lead by beating Caroline Garcia 6-4, 6-4 in the semifinals. The Czechs will face Germany or Russia in November for the title.

d3fa77054ea29a612446deb166f7a1b6.text: Olympic gold medallist Jessica Ennis-Hill has confirmed she will return to competition at the Sainsbury's Anniversary Games in the London Olympic Stadium on July 24 and 25. Having taken a break from athletics to have a baby, the 29-year-old plans to use the event to test her readiness for the Rio Olympics.

edf34041ff0371fd3d386efcdc45abab.text: On Tuesday, 58-year-old actress Rita Wilson announced that she recently underwent a double mastectomy and reconstructive surgery for invasive lobular carcinoma. After an initial negative test, Wilson sought a second opinion, which led to the correct diagnosis. She is currently recovering and expected to make a full recovery.

a3ed56c63d0d95daeaedd31c23bf836d.text: Liverpool manager Brendan Rodgers announced that winger Jordon Ibe is ready to return for Monday's home match against Newcastle after recovering from a knee ligament injury sustained six weeks ago in Istanbul against Besiktas. Meanwhile, striker Mario Balotelli will miss the game due to injury and illness.

6769bcc950fc33cd651c4a8833cf823d.text: In Auckland, New Zealand, 22-year-old Tegan Peters found a tennis ball covered in over 20 sharp pins and broken pieces at Ti Rakau Park. Believing the object was deliberately designed to harm animals or children, she posted a warning on Facebook to alert the local community and animal welfare pages.

b6891a58b484a029cc4f2e07446c7fa9.text: Tottenham Hotspur midfielder Christian Eriksen warned in 2015 that the Premier League club will struggle to attract top players if they miss out on European qualification. Currently sitting sixth in the table, Eriksen stated that playing in the Europa League was a major factor in his own decision to join Spurs in 2013.

dc9b8cdde7b687d1a9cf0f2cdce83065.text: Three stylists known for working with Australian stars made The Hollywood Reporter’s 2015 Power Stylists list. Elizabeth Stewart placed sixth for styling Cate Blanchett and others. Cristina Ehrlich ranked eighth for styling Margot Robbie and Isabel Lucas, while Naomi Watts's longtime stylist Jeanann Williams placed ninth.

e9937df8e59d4f753a6db958973b1fb1.text: Hillary Clinton has officially declared her candidacy for president online. Her previous experience as secretary of state is expected to be a major advantage in the campaign, but she faces challenges balancing her support for the Obama administration's foreign policies with distancing herself from its vulnerabilities, particularly regarding Iran.

891858eb632627afe62dd24f0294022b.text: Last year at Wesleyan University in Middletown, Connecticut, 19-year-old sophomore Summer Elbardissy suffered a traumatic brain injury after falling from a third-story window at the Beta Theta Pi fraternity house. While intoxicated and attempting to reach a roof deck, she fell, requiring extensive hospitalization and months of relearning basic skills.

4ccde1e80133388efd6418dc238f1add.text: Amateur cyclist Dave Sim, a 36-year-old personal trainer from Southport, Merseyside, plans to ride the entire 2,077-mile 2015 Tour de France route this summer aboard a modified Raleigh Chopper. Sim hopes his stunt will inspire people to take up cycling and raise money for the charity Help for Heroes.
